Hands Down, the BEST in Hoi An
Aug 2026 • Family
We stayed in Hoi A for over 3 weeks, and this place was hands down, the BEST restaurant we found!! We first had lemongrass chicken and Cao Lao, and they were the most flavorful dishes we ever had in town. I had already tasted Cau Lau 3 previous times, but this one was the best.
